system.name: DualHyp
system.one_liner: A generative error correction framework for audio-visual speech recognition in which an LLM composes separate ASR and VSR N-best hypotheses.

content.variant_note: the same bottom-up pipeline drawn twice, baseline at left and the proposed framework at right (wider), with every changed part in red
content.argues: Keeping ASR and VSR hypotheses as two separate N-best sets in language space lets the LLM cross-reference them and correct errors that a single-set GER framework leaves.
content.subject: Two lanes: one ASR list into an LLM with an adapter, versus ASR and VSR lists into an LLM with LoRA

evidence: Our DualHyp framework maintains modality separation, using both ASR and VSR heads to generate two distinct sets of textual hypotheses.
Conventional GER frameworks use a single set of ASR hypotheses and (optionally) injects visual features via an adapter
The LLM performs compositional reasoning on dual hypotheses in the language space to produce a more robust and accurate transcription.

summary: DualHyp is a generative error correction framework for audio-visual speech recognition: an LLM reads two separate N-best hypothesis lists, one from an ASR head and one from a VSR (lip-reading) head. Figure 1 puts two bottom-up lanes side by side. In (a) the conventional approach turns audio into one ASR N-best list that goes to an LLM with an adapter, while the lip video is only a dashed grey side input. In (b) audio and lip video feed ASR and VSR, the two lists sit in a red dashed frame joined by a red plus, and go with a quoted prompt to an LLM with LoRA, which outputs a different sentence. Snowflake and flame emoji mark frozen and trainable parts; red is kept for the proposed path.
summary_zh: DualHyp 让 LLM 同时参考 ASR 与唇读 VSR 各自的 N-best 假设来纠错。左右两条自下而上的通路对比：(a) 只用一份 ASR 假设；(b) 两份假设用红框和加号合并，加提示词送入带 LoRA 的 LLM。
